title: What is the monthly average number of schools that opened in Alameda County
question: What is the monthly average number of schools that opened in Alameda County under the jurisdiction of the Elementary School District in 1980?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT AVG(monthly_count) AS monthly_average
FROM (
    SELECT strftime('%m', OpenDate) AS month, COUNT(*) AS monthly_count
    FROM SchoolInfo
    WHERE County = 'Alameda'
      AND DOCType = 'Elementary School District'
      AND strftime('%Y', OpenDate) = '1980'
    GROUP BY strftime('%m', OpenDate)
)

react.initial_search_query: What is the monthly average number of schools that opened in Alameda County under the jurisdiction of the Elementary School District in 1980?

prefetched_grounding.provenance: deterministic read-only database probes; no model-authored claims

react.raw_react_sql: SELECT AVG(monthly_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT("SchoolInfo"."CDSCode") AS monthly_count FROM "SchoolInfo" JOIN "SchoolLocation" ON "SchoolInfo"."CDSCode" = "SchoolLocation"."CDSCode" WHERE "SchoolInfo"."DOCType" = 'Elementary School District' AND "SchoolLocation"."County" = 'Alameda' AND STRFTIME('%Y', "SchoolInfo"."OpenDate") = '1980' GROUP BY STRFTIME('%m', "SchoolInfo"."OpenDate"))
